data.yaml:
global:
  scrape_interval: 30s
  scrape_timeout: 10s
  evaluation_interval: 30s
  external_labels:
    cluster: prod-us-east-1
    prometheus: monitoring/k8s
    region: us-east-1
scrape_configs:
- job_name: kubelet
  honor_timestamps: true
  scheme: https
  authorization:
    type: Bearer
    credentials: <secret>
  kubernetes_sd_configs:
  - role: node
